en: Black‑and‑white view along a bridge beside a lake or wide river. A few pedestrians walk on the roadway, which is lined on the right by slender birch trees; railings run along both sides of the bridge. Low hills and a town with scattered buildings appear in the distance. At the bottom edge there is small printed caption text and a handwritten‑style signature in the lower right, typical of vintage postcards.
